name: social-media-ad-research
description: Research competitors' ads and social content from your AI agent: search the Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn and Google ad libraries, YouTube videos, channels and transcripts, Instagram's trending Reels, Threads posts and Reddit discussions. Find the longest-running ads, compare creatives and offers, mine pain points and customer language from comments, and export CSV. Pay per result on your Apify account.
